FROM posts p INNER JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 0

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, u.username, COALESCE(u.image, 'default_avatar.png') AS image, p.view_count, p.reply_count, p.last_reply_time, p.collect_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 0 ORDER BY p.is_top DESC, p.last_reply_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, u.username, COALESCE(u.image, 'default_avatar.png') AS image, p.view_count, p.reply_count, p.last_reply_time, p.collect_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 0 AND section_id = #{sectionId} ORDER BY p.is_top DESC, p.last_reply_time DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE posts
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
section_id = #{sectionId},
view_count = #{viewCount},
reply_count = #{replyCount},
last_reply_time = #{lastReplyTime},
is_top = #{isTop},
is_essence = #{isEssence},
status = #{status},
collect_count = #{collectCount},
like_count = #{likeCount},
updated_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, content, user_id, section_id, created_time, updated_time, view_count, reply_count, last_reply_time, is_top, is_essence, status, collect_count, like_count) VALUES (#{title},#{content},#{userId},#{sectionId},#{createdTime},#{updatedTime},#{viewCount},#{replyCount},#{lastReplyTime},#{isTop},#{isEssence},#{status},#{collectCount},#{likeCount})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, p.section_id AS sectionId, s.name AS sectionName, s.image AS sectionImage, p.created_time AS createdTime, p.reply_count AS replyCount FROM posts p INNER JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sections s ON p.section_id = s.id INNER JOIN section_follows sf ON sf.section_id = s.id WHERE sf.user_id = #{userId} -- 查询用户关注的版块 AND p.status = 0 -- 只查询状态正常的帖子 ORDER BY p.reply_count DESC -- 按回复数量从高到低排序

SELECT p.id, p.created_time AS createdTime, p.title, p.reply_count AS replyCount, p.section_id AS sectionId, s.name AS sectionName FROM posts p INNER JOIN sections s ON p.section_id = s.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 0 -- 只查询正常状态的帖子 ORDER BY p.created_time DESC

SELECT p.id AS id, p.title AS title, p.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, p.created_time AS createdTime FROM user_post_collections c INNER JOIN posts p ON c.post_id = p.id INNER JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 -- 只查询已收藏状态 AND p.status = 0 -- 只查询正常状态的帖子 ORDER BY c.created_time DESC -- 按收藏时间倒序

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.section_id AS sectionId, s.name AS sectionName, p.created_time AS createdTime FROM posts p JOIN sections s ON p.section_id = s.id WHERE p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.title = #{keyword} THEN 1 WHEN p.title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, LOCATE(#{keyword}, p.title), p.created_time DESC
